contexts.text: Vegetation is produced by means of outer barks, inner barks, and coats.
Three atmospheres environing the former ones... as bark does wood.
As the coats (clothe) the nerves, and the tunicle their fibres.

This thought and that will, taken together, may be compared to the inner bark which adheres to the inside of the outer bark of a tree... Within these is the inward natural man, which, if evil, may be compared to the wood of a rotten tree, around which the said outer bark with its inner bark appears entire.
